avoid: Complex footwork that requires high coordination
children.game_version: A 'follow-the-leader' game where children mimic the 'bouncy' walk of the pachanga.

avoid: Deep knee bends that strain the joints
Rapid weight shifts that compromise balance
seniors.seated_version: Perform the knee-bounce while seated by lifting heels and engaging the core.
seniors.standing_version: Hold onto a stable chair for balance while practicing the weight shift.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to a comfortable pace; limit the depth of knee bends.

movement_profile.footwork: Gliding weight transfer mimicking a moonwalk.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Upper body rocks in response to knee-driven weight changes.
movement_profile.posture: Grounded with knees never fully straightening.

signature_moves.description: An improvised dance move popularized at the Triton Club.
signature_moves.name: Bronx Hop

music_profile.sound_description: A bright, rhythmic sound driven by high-pitched violins and flutes, characterized by repetitive riffs and a persistent, bouncy downbeat.

basic_steps: Bend and straighten knees continuously without locking.
Shift weight from one foot to the other with a glide.
Rock the upper body to maintain connectivity.
teaching.level_notes: Focus on keeping the knees bent and grounded to achieve the characteristic glide.
